esc_2021_confused_with_esc_2023.evidence: 2/8 ESC 2021 queries have ESC 2023 in top-5

esc_2023_confused_with_esc_2021.evidence: 6/6 ESC 2023 queries have ESC 2021 in top-5

corpus_dilution_nice.evidence: 7/8 NICE queries have non-NICE content in top-5

cross_document_failures.evidence: 8 cross-doc queries: 2 miss NICE, 0 miss ESC

first_result_accuracy.evidence: 7/30 queries have wrong doc as top-1 result

F_comparison_to_nice_only_baseline.explanation: NICE-only queries saw major drops when corpus expanded from 45 to 1001 chunks. P@1 fell from 0.95 to 0.5 (-47.4%), nDCG@5 fell from 0.8064 to 0.4837 (-40.0%), and MRR fell from 0.9667 to 0.6562 (-32.1%). This confirms the corpus dilution effect: semantically similar ESC chunks compete with and outrank the correct NICE chunks.

G_key_findings.finding: Corpus dilution caused massive degradation for NICE queries
G_key_findings.evidence: NICE P@1 dropped from 0.95 to 0.5 (7/8 NICE queries have ESC in top-5). nDCG@5 dropped from 0.8064 to 0.4837.

G_key_findings.finding: Cross-document queries dominate the worst performers
G_key_findings.evidence: 7/8 bottom nDCG@5 queries are cross-document. Cross-doc MRR=0.5104 vs NICE MRR=0.6562.

G_key_findings.finding: ESC 2021 and ESC 2023 content compete heavily with each other
G_key_findings.evidence: 2/8 ESC 2021 queries retrieve ESC 2023 content; 6/6 ESC 2023 queries retrieve ESC 2021 content.

G_key_findings.finding: The embedding model (BGE-small-en) struggles with document-specific queries
G_key_findings.evidence: Only 50% of NICE queries retrieve the correct doc at rank 1. Queries with document qualifiers (e.g., 'according to NICE') still retrieve wrong docs.

G_key_findings.finding: Recall ceiling is low even for best-performing categories
G_key_findings.evidence: Best Recall@5 is 0.47 (NICE), meaning even good queries miss most relevant chunks in top-5.

G_key_findings.finding: First-result accuracy is poor across the board
G_key_findings.evidence: 7/30 queries (23.3%) have a wrong-document chunk at rank 1.

G_key_findings.finding: Latency remained stable despite 22x corpus growth
G_key_findings.evidence: Median latency 43.64ms (new) vs 42.5ms (old) on 1001 vs 45 chunks.

H_recommended_next_experiment.rationale: The dominant failure mode is corpus dilution (7/8 NICE queries retrieve ESC content, 7/30 queries have wrong doc at rank 1). The current metadata filter only excludes 'Front matter' but does not help route queries to the correct document. A document-source metadata filter (nice/esc_2021/esc_2023) on each chunk would allow the retrieval to be scoped to the correct document when the query specifies a document, while still allowing cross-document queries to search all documents.
H_recommended_next_experiment.expected_impact: Should dramatically improve NICE queries (currently P@1=0.5, target P@1>=0.85) and ESC document-specific queries, while maintaining cross-document query performance.
H_recommended_next_experiment.alternative: If metadata filtering is not feasible, the next best experiment would be cross-encoder reranking, which can re-score results to boost correct-document chunks.
